text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Nnn...
No way... Not the sauce, anything but the sauce!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Next thing I knew, I was lyin' on a griddle, and they poured okonomiyaki batter right all over me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If they poured sauce on me too, it'd be all over!
I screamed out!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And then I wake up, over and over again...
*sigh* I really didn't get enough sleep...
